heading: Appropriations for universities
lead: There is hereby appropriated to each recipient University named above or to the trustee of the fund designated by the President of the University the sum of $800,000 to carry out the provisions of section 4516 of this title, to be available on November 1, 1987, and to remain available until expended.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 99–591 is a corrected version of Pub. L. 99–500.
